user_direction: Reject new low-level controller; prefer parameter adjustment; MuJoCo position mode allowed
backend: Unmodified MuJoCo position servo; no custom torque controller or gravity feedforward

reference.use_of_armature: Gain response scaling only; NO armature copied to source joints

derivation: Scale reference kp and kv by I_source/(I_source+I_reference_armature) to approximately preserve reference response frequency/damping relative to source inertia. Static parameter derivation only, no runtime dynamics control law.

mimic.solref_basis: 2 times native2ms timestep; also supplier MJCF equality reference
mimic.solimp_basis: Existing supplier numerical equality profile; no source mechanical compliance claimed

change_from_first_candidate: Only integrator changes; same fixed position kp/kv and equality settings at2ms timestep

joint_limit_numerics.scope: Only11 DH116 joint limit solver parameters; all source physical limit ranges unchanged
joint_limit_numerics.basis: Same two-timestep numeric response used for source mimic; reduce observed0.0087rad soft limit overlap
